full_page.content:
1934, August
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 208 Cont.
Aug. 5 Mrs. Emily Villennove - 62 - several strokes last 25 yrs. - has large Fam. husband and son not working. Fam. without work .... Br. Seraphin
Mrs. Anna Sonalley - 43 - inward cancer - very low .... McNulty boy 11 - Fever of 106 Mother asks prayers. WmMcGlynn - 77 - stomach & liver ...
Dr. Zenger - given up last week - sitting up - enjoying radio ..
Page 209
Aug. 11 John Kloka - 48 - 3 mo. stroke.
11 Lucile Mahr - 24 - hopelessly enemic - gave quart of blood to ... last winter - Enrolled To-day (50c)
Cath. Schlaff - 70 - cancer - contin. pail
12 Mrs. Jessie Boyle - 76 - Mother of Frank - who .. . had accident six mo. ago and was burned Monday (13) - Mrs. B. still invalid from in- juries in said accident, asks prayers.
Patricia Larkin - 9 - Kidney trouble
Margaret Kelly - bout 50 - mental ....
14 Joseph Parsenski - 57 - infected eye - fear loss of same enrolled last night - no better so far - though less pain last night -slept. Jos. Lafatta - 13 - mastoid - Jeff Cl. - wants blood transfusion
Norman St. Louis - 8 - Tecumsch Ont. - Scarlet fever - complication Hopeless - Enrolled June 8th (Br. Fr. ) absolutely hopeless ... Now O. K. - though weak - enrolled Today perpetually.
Page 210 Aug. 14 Two wonderful favors through Intercession of Fr. Stephen and use of his relic - Mrs. Jones - 52 Ferris Ave. - Hyland Park, Apt. 103
Dr. F. X. Zinger - 51 - enrolled July 11 for cancer of stomach - op- eration started August Ist but abandoned as hopeless. Enrolled a- gain August 4th perpetually. That was Saturday. Monday, 6th, phone message ... Dr.Z. wonderfully improving - Wife & nurse report.
